fields.Name: AIUsageErrorRateByModel
fields.UserQuestion: What is the error rate and failure frequency for each AI model and vendor?
fields.Description: Calculates execution success and failure volumes and computes error rate percentages across models and vendors.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Aggregates vwAIUsageFacts by VendorID and ModelID, measuring total runs, succeeded runs, failed runs, and ErrorRatePct. Supports optional start and end date filtering.
